rationale: The agent executed an exchange for the desk lamp but did not process the water bottle exchange requested by the user. While tool calls suggest the agent may have identified the user and referenced the correct order and payment method, the lack of a confirmation step and incomplete fulfillment of the user’s request mean the outcome does not meet the pass bar.
